subject.title: [Bug] v2026.5.22 启动后 Gateway CPU 持续 100%+，导致请求延迟飙升 50-100 倍

question: Should default gateway startup stop running the provider-auth warm sweep and keep only the auth-failure rewarm plus explicit opt-in warm path?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it changes the auth-provider startup contract for existing users by trading eager prepared auth state for startup responsiveness.

options.title: Land default-off hook-only startup
options.body: Repair and land the open maintainer PR so startup stays responsive by default while auth-failure rewarm and explicit startup warm remain available.

options.title: Keep eager startup prewarm
options.body: Close or reject the default-off direction and document the environment opt-out as the supported workaround for operators who hit CPU pressure.

options.title: Design a different opt-in control
options.body: Pause the candidate PR and choose a different explicit config or doctor-guided recovery path before changing defaults.

recommendation.title: Land default-off hook-only startup
recommendation.body: Repair and land the open maintainer PR so startup stays responsive by default while auth-failure rewarm and explicit startup warm remain available.

likelyOwner.reason: The open maintainer PR and recent proof already cover the default-off startup contract under review.
